title: Common clopen refinement of completed projective charts
statement: Fix l and E and completed integral coefficient sheaves [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Let f:V→W be any morphism with V affine [def-pc-scheme]. Let M,N be complexes of module sheaves on W [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category] whose ordinary uncompleted derived pullbacks to V [def-sf-ordinary-integral-derived-pullback] are complete [def-weil-derived-complete]. Suppose separately for each of these two restrictions there is a finite disjoint open cover of V and, on every member, a bounded cochain complex of retracts of finite products of the completed unit sheaf representing its completed derived pullback [def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. Then a single finite disjoint open cover of V works for both M and N, each member is qcqs, and on each member there is such a bounded finite-projective cochain complex representing the ordinary derived pullback along the composite from that member to W. The differentials remain arbitrary sheaf-linear maps.

proof.text: Obtain one finite disjoint cover for M and one for N from the input models. Each member is clopen, since its complement is the open union of the other members. Intersect the two covers and reindex their product using finProdFinEquiv. The intersections cover, are pairwise disjoint and closed in the affine compact scheme V, hence compact; their open embeddings into the quasi-separated affine scheme V give quasi-separatedness.

For a chosen refined member and its containing original chart, use the published normalized exact open restriction F. Its coefficient ring comparison and unitToPushforwardObjUnit identify F of the unit with the local unit (reflecting isomorphisms on underlying abelian presheaves). Apply clopen_completed_restriction_comparison to identify the ordinary composite pullback of K with D(F) of its completed chart, using the given completeness on V.

Apply F termwise to the original chart complex. Its preserved zero morphisms preserve both strict bounds. Map the specified splitting maps and compose with PreservesProduct.iso and Pi.mapIso of the unit identification. Functoriality and the inverse identities show their composite is the identity, retaining the same finite ranks. Compose the comparison of step 2, D(F) of the given chart isomorphism, and F.mapDerivedCategoryFactors to represent the ordinary composite pullback by this complex. Use the M-cover or N-cover according to K=M or K=N.

lean.statement:
theorem clopen_projective_chart_common_refinement
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (W V : Scheme.{u}) (f : V ⟶ W) [IsAffine V]
    (M N : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E W))
    (_hcomplete : ∀ K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E W),
      K = M ∨ K = N → IntegralOnSlice.IsComplete l E V none
        ((ordinaryIntegralDerivedPull l E f).obj K))
    (_hmodels : ∀ K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E W),
      K = M ∨ K = N →
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (U : Fin n → V.Opens),
      (⨆ i, U i) = ⊤ ∧
      Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (U i) (U j)) ∧
      ∀ i : Fin n,
        ∃ (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules.{u, u} l E (U i).toScheme) ℤ)
          (a b : ℤ),
          a ≤ b ∧ P.IsStrictlyGE a ∧ P.IsStrictlyLE b ∧
          (∀ r : ℤ, ∃ (N : ℕ)
            (ι : P.X r ⟶ ∏ᶜ fun _ : Fin N ↦
              SheafOfModules.unit
                (completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted l E (U i).toScheme))
            (ρ : (∏ᶜ fun _ : Fin N ↦
              SheafOfModules.unit
                (completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted l E (U i).toScheme))
              ⟶ P.X r),
            ι ≫ ρ = 𝟙 _) ∧
          Nonempty
            ((integralDerivedPullback l E (U i).ι).obj ((ordinaryIntegralDerivedPull l E f).obj K) ≅
              DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)) :
          ∃ (c : ℕ) (U : Fin c → V.Opens),
            (⨆ i, U i) = ⊤ ∧ Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (U i) (U j)) ∧
            (∀ i, CompactSpace (U i).toScheme) ∧
            (∀ i, QuasiSeparatedSpace (U i).toScheme) ∧
            ∀ (i : Fin c) (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E W)),
              K = M ∨ K = N →
              ∃ (P : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E (U i).toScheme) ℤ)
                (a b : ℤ), a ≤ b ∧ P.IsStrictlyGE a ∧ P.IsStrictlyLE b ∧
                (∀ q : ℤ, ∃ (r : ℕ)
                  (ι : P.X q ⟶ ∏ᶜ fun _ : Fin r ↦ SheafOfModules.unit
                    (completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted l E (U i).toScheme))
                  (ρ : (∏ᶜ fun _ : Fin r ↦ SheafOfModules.unit
                    (completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted l E (U i).toScheme))
                    ⟶ P.X q), ι ≫ ρ = 𝟙 _) ∧
                Nonempty ((ordinaryIntegralDerivedPull l E
                  ((U i).ι ≫ f)).obj K ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)
